description: This file defines a React component 'MindmapCanvas' which renders an interactive, zoomable, and pannable mind map visualization using SVG. It includes logic for computing node layout, handling user interactions (zoom with mouse wheel, drag panning, node clicking), and rendering nodes and edges with labels and styles. The component relies on external node and edge data types from an API module.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Constrains a number within a specified min and max range.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Normalizes an input value to a trimmed string, handling null or undefined gracefully.

methods.name: computeLayout
methods.description: Computes a node layout for the mind map using BFS levels, with nodes positioned in vertical columns based on graph structure, ensuring clarity and readability.

methods.name: getNodeColor
methods.description: Determines fill color for nodes based on their state (center, selected, dimmed).

methods.name: getNodeStroke
methods.description: Determines stroke color for nodes based on their state.

methods.name: wrapLabel
methods.description: Wraps a given text label into multiple lines with ellipsis truncation, fitting within specified character and line limits.

methods.name: MindmapCanvas
methods.description: Main React functional component for rendering an interactive mind map with zoom, pan, and click interactions.
